content: {"like":["Prefers action-packed, well-staged sci‑fi adventures with strong special effects.","Values complex plots with conspiracies and epic lightsaber battles.","Enjoys deep character introductions, especially young Anakin and Obi‑Wan.","Loves detailed behind‑the‑scenes documentaries and cast interviews.","Favors classic horror with atmospheric, scary performances by Lee and Cushing."],"dislike":["Dislikes cheesy or poorly written love stories in sci‑fi films.","Avoids weak acting, such as Hayden Christensen’s performance.","Rejects releases with poor reconstruction or missing episode coherence.","Dislikes lack of subtitles or proper title sequences in archival material.","Avoids content lacking horror elements or campy, boring characters."]}
